title: Google title and description
now: How it looks on Google now
nowApplied: How it will look on Google (applied)
optionsIntro: Generated {time}. You can tweak the text before applying it.
confirmTitle: Change the Google title and description?
confirmBody: The post “{title}” is PUBLISHED: only its meta title and meta description change (not the content, slug or status). You can restore the previous ones.
restoreTitle: Restore the previous title and description?
restoreBody: The values the post had before applying come back.
footnote: Only meta_title and meta_description of the published post are touched. If someone changes them in Ghost meanwhile, they are not overwritten.

result.conflict: The title or description changed in Ghost since the proposal: nothing was touched. Press “Propose others” to start from the current ones.
result.failed: Ghost did not accept the change. Check the logs.
result.unavailable: There is nothing to apply or restore.

follow.pending: The result shows up a few days after applying, when you press “Refresh” on Ideas.
follow.noData: No impressions for that search from {from} to {to}.
